descricao_original: For this tissue preparation, the vascular supply was injected with a red dye to highlight the large number of capillaries present in the islets of Langerhans. The capillaries receive the islet hormones for distribution throughout the body, as well as deliver metabolic and hormonal signals to the islet cells to regulate their secretion. 400x
creditos_identificados: Image source: Image taken of a slide in the University of Michigan collection.
